dct_description_sm: Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Shows topography, drainage, territorial boundaries of the tribes of Israel, places of historical interest.
Each map has a decorative title cartouche with illustrations of men, angels, and settlements.

[1] Conspectus Palaestinae a priscis incolis inhabitatae tempore Josuae -- [2] Conspectus Palaestinae uti divisa fuit a Mose et Josuae inter XII tribus Israeliticas -- [3] Conspectus Palaestinae et regionum, in quas distributa fuit stante Templo secundo et aliquo tempore post eius exidium -- [4] Conspectus Palaestinae divisae in primam, secundam et tertiam ut erat circa initium saeculi aerae Christianae quinti.
